{
  "name": "methodical",
  "displayName": "Methodical Adaptive Gated Engineering",
  "version": "0.11.0",
  "description": "Methodical gated engineering with shared native routing and portable project records. Requires supported native hooks and Node.js.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Chris Myers",
    "url": "https://github.com/BigLeverVentures"
  },
  "repository": "https://github.com/BigLeverVentures/methodical-gated-engineering",
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "workflow",
    "planning",
    "code-review",
    "compound-engineering"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "decider": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Decider model",
      "description": "Sits every deciding seat: the plan, plan review, and the correctness, rigor and code-grounded review seats. Each role runs at a fixed effort; this sets only the model.",
      "options": [
        "fable",
        "opus",
        "sonnet",
        "haiku"
      ],
      "default": "opus"
    },
    "worker": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Worker model",
      "description": "Writes up solutions and sits the research and simplicity seats; your session orchestrates and builds at its own model and effort. Each role runs at a fixed effort; this sets only the model.",
      "options": [
        "fable",
        "opus",
        "sonnet",
        "haiku"
      ],
      "default": "sonnet"
    },
    "census": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Census model",
      "description": "Search, census and the North Star check. Each role runs at a fixed effort; this sets only the model.",
      "options": [
        "fable",
        "opus",
        "sonnet",
        "haiku"
      ],
      "default": "sonnet"
    },
    "backstop": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Backstop model",
      "description": "Sits the escalated review: the final re-review of a lean or full unit and, at full, the code-grounded, rigor and correctness seats. Set it to the decider's model to turn the extra pass into a repeat. Each role runs at a fixed effort; this sets only the model.",
      "options": [
        "fable",
        "opus",
        "sonnet",
        "haiku"
      ],
      "default": "fable"
    },
    "nudgePercent": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Compound offer (percent of the window)",
      "description": "Offers a compound checkpoint when the conversation reaches this percent of the model's context window, from 1 to 100 (100 turns this offer off). It only offers; it never compacts.",
      "default": 45
    },
    "nudgeReserve": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Second offer reserve (tokens)",
      "description": "A second offer, before the host's compaction threshold, comes when this many tokens or fewer remain, so there is room to compound first. A value that is not positive uses the default; the reserve is never more than a fifth of the threshold.",
      "default": 120000
    },
    "offer": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Offer to compound before compacting",
      "description": "on: the early warning, the question at a typed /compact and the line after a compaction. off: none of them (the compaction summary is still asked to keep your lessons and rulings).",
      "options": [
        "on",
        "off"
      ],
      "default": "on"
    }
  }
}
